informational: TableColumn takes an optional hint: the ds-table header label gets a dotted underline and shows the hint in a tooltip on hover and keyboard focus. A non-sortable label with a hint renders as a button styled like the label; a sortable one keeps its sort button as the only Tab stop. While the label is clipped the tooltip shows the label and then the hint; otherwise the hint alone.

informational.text: A ds-table header label wider than its column clips with an ellipsis inside the column instead of running over the next header; the sort icon and the filter button stay visible. A header that fits renders as before.
informational.verify: set a narrow width on a sortable, a plain and a filterable column with a long label and confirm each label ends in an ellipsis inside its column, the sort icon and filter button stay visible, and no label overlaps the next header.
